settings.heading: Returns & exchanges
settings.body:
Because each piece is made for you specifically, we can't restock returns. That said, we don't want you stuck with something wrong.

Damaged or misprinted

Write to us within 30 days of delivery with a photo and we'll remake it or refund it. No need to send the original back.

Wrong size

Check the size guide before ordering — that's the honest advice. If it still arrives wrong, contact us within 30 days and we'll work it out.

Wrong address

If a package comes back to us because the address was incorrect, we'll reship it once you confirm the correct one. Reshipping is at your cost.

Changed your mind

Email us within two hours of ordering and we can usually cancel before production starts. After that the piece is already being made.
